decisions.reason: As a flagship organic line with several models that closely fits the firm's stated direction and existing capabilities, it is likely to stay unless early sales fall well below aspiration levels.
This product is close to the core business and supports the organic expansion, but as a narrower snack niche without flagship status it faces a somewhat higher risk if performance is only modest.

A premium sharing snack line with several models fits the firm's broad assortment and meat-specialty know-how, so boundedly rational management would likely keep it while results remain uncertain but acceptable.
